d.seg: आ जाओ कभी हैदराबाद आ जाओ कभी हैदराबाद आ जाओ कभी हैदराबाद आ जाओ
d.tr: Come to Hyderabad, come to Hyderabad, come to Hyderabad.
d.ctx: The user repeatedly invites the expert to meet in person in Hyderabad. The expert responds by saying she is planning to come.
d.j: The user is proposing to meet in person, which is a strong case for PlatformMove.

d.seg: आ जाओ दोनों घूम के आ जाएंगे
d.tr: Come, we will both go around and visit.
d.ctx: The user suggests they will go around together once the expert visits Hyderabad.
d.j: The user is proposing to meet in person, which is a strong case for PlatformMove.
